title: Software Engineering Intern
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go, and foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
description: Work on software development projects critical to Google's needs, gaining real-world industry experience across scale systems and infrastructure.

title: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme Scholarship
eligibility: Graduates from developing countries with a degree in Social Sciences, Political Science, Law, Economics, or Public Policy.
qualification: Bachelor's degree with above-average results and relevant practical experience.
description: Supports future leaders from developing countries studying Master's programs relevant to social, political, and economic development in Germany.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Candidates with authorization to work remotely in their country of residence.
qualification: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and framework experience with Vue.js or React.
description: Develop user interface components, optimize core application user experience, and collaborate asynchronously across a global remote team.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup
eligibility: Students aged 18 or older enrolled in an accredited educational institution.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Azure Credits
qualification: Enrolled student status with a tech-driven startup concept utilizing Microsoft Azure.
description: Global technology competition encouraging students to build innovative solution projects that address real-world community and business issues.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or professionals with 0-2 years of software product experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
description: Lead product development cycles from research to launch, aligning design and engineering teams to build marketplace features.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to all learners globally with an internet connection.
qualification: No prior programming or computer science experience required.
description: An introductory computer science course covering algorithmic thinking, C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
